title: Reasoning Again with a Quarter of the Experts: Retry First, Then Train
abstract: arXiv:2611.20419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Removing three quarters of the routed experts from a 122B-parameter reasoning mixture-of-experts model makes it fit in a 12 GiB file, and breaks it in a specific way: on LiveCodeBench it enters verbatim reasoning loops that run to the token limit on 44 of 120 development problems, where the unpruned model at the same 2-bit quantization loops on none. We study how much of that loss can be recovered without changing the kept experts' quantized bytes, in three steps of increasing cost. On development problems, a sampling penalty recovers part of it. Stopping a reply when it starts to loop and drawing again recovers more on top of it, with no weight change. Our method, B, adds rank-8 trained corrections to the kept experts, loaded as an adapter, and restores two experts per layer; it is fitted layer by layer to the unpruned model's expert block on the pruned model's own activations. In a pre-registered comparison on 130 easy and medium LiveC

translated_title: 用四分之一的专家重新推理：先重试，再训练
translated_abstract: 从一个122B参数的推理混合专家模型中移除四分之三的路由专家后，模型可以压缩进一个12 GiB的文件中，但它会以特定方式被破坏：在LiveCodeBench上，120个开发问题中有44个会陷入逐字重复的推理循环并一直运行到token上限，而在相同的2比特量化下，未剪枝的模型没有任何此类循环。我们研究了在不改变保留专家量化字节的前提下，通过三个成本递增的步骤能恢复多少性能损失。在开发问题上，采样惩罚能恢复其中一部分损失；当回复开始循环时将其停止并重新采样，可以在不改变权重的情况下进一步恢复更多。我们的方法B以适配器形式为保留的专家添加rank-8训练修正，并恢复每层两个专家；该方法在剪枝模型自身的激活上，逐层拟合到未剪枝模型的专家块。在一项预先注册的、针对130个简单和中等难度LiveC（原文摘要在此处截断）……的对比实验中……
tldr: 针对剪枝至四分之一专家的推理MoE模型陷入逐字推理循环的问题，论文提出“先重试、再训练”的三级递进恢复方案——先用采样惩罚、再用循环检测后重采样这两种免训练手段恢复大部分损失，最后通过逐层拟合的rank-8适配器并恢复每层两个专家，在不改动保留专家量化字节的前提下显著恢复模型性能。
en_tdlr: For a 75%-pruned reasoning MoE that gets stuck in verbatim reasoning loops, retry-first interventions (sampling penalty, then stopping and resampling looping replies) recover much of the loss without any weight change, and a cheap layer-wise rank-8 adapter with two restored experts per layer recovers more.
